subject: EmbStore operations: SLAs, incident play, and handoff schedule
messages:
From: Amit Shah <amit@pinecone.io>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>; Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Leah Park <leah@weaviate-partners.com>; support@pinecone.io
Date: Thu, 17 Sep 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Joint EmbStore ops proposal (SLA + incident play)

Hi Monica / Ben —

Thanks again for the sync today. As discussed, Pinecone is ready to pilot a hybrid "EmbStore" flow where live vectors are served by Pinecone and cold spill / archival lives in S3-backed pgvector buckets for customers who want a lower-cost cold lane. To make this work for production customers at scale we propose a short ops contract that covers:

- 99.9% read availability for hot namespace (region: us-west) with proactive alerts
- Defined RTO/RPO for cold restore (we suggest RTO = 2 hours, RPO = 1 hour for index rebuilds)
- Joint incident play: who takes lead for hot read failures vs. cold retrieval regressions
- Runbook and on-call rotation for the pilot (first 90 days)

Attached is a first-pass SLA + incident-play doc (embstore-sla-draft-v1.pdf). Leah from Weaviate is also on this thread to comment on data model compatibility (we discussed a common metadata header for spilled vectors).

Can your team review and call out any non-starters (billing splits, ownership of restores, encryption key handoffs)? We'd like to lock in responsibilities this week so engineering can scope the canary.

Thanks—
Amit
Pinecone — Strategic Partnerships

Attachment: embstore-sla-draft-v1.pdf
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit@pinecone.io>, Leah Park <leah@weaviate-partners.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Sep 2026 18:14:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Joint EmbStore ops proposal (SLA + incident play)

Thanks Amit — appreciate the clear framing and the draft. Quick internal alignment from our side before we mark things as final: 

Ben / Vanessa / Karthik — quick asks so we can give Pinecone a single reference reply: 
- Commercials: Pinecone proposes a 60/40 read-cost split on hybrid requests (hot reads billed to Pinecone’s managed tier, cold retrievals split). Is that acceptable from revenue-ops? Ben — PTAL and flag if you need a formal cost model.
- Ownership of restores: we prefer pinecone-initiated restores for any warm-up reads (they have the efficient read path), but Redwood will be responsible for initiating bulk reindexes from S3 for emergency restores. Need to document exact callouts in playbook (see incident-playbook-embstore.md).
- Encryption/KMS handoff: Redwood legal wants customer keys to remain in-customer KMS for archived data. Karthik — we need one sentence confirming feasibility and any perf/timing impacts.

Amit / Leah — we can take the SLA doc and PR comments inline. I’ll drop proposed edits in the Drive link tonight and can host a 30-min alignment Friday to lock responsibilities and canary dates.

Proposed timeline:
- Fri 18 Sep: internal comments incorporated
- Mon 21 Sep: partner alignment call and signoff on playbook
- Wed 23 Sep: canary deploy to 10 customers, 7-day observation

Attaching draft incident playbook for structure reference.

Monica Patel
Head of Partner Ops, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

Attachment: incident-playbook-embstore.md
From: Amit Shah <amit@pinecone.io>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Leah Park <leah@weaviate-partners.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Joint EmbStore ops proposal (SLA + incident play)

Perfect — thanks for the fast turn. Quick replies inline: 

- Commercials: 60/40 split is OK as a starting point for the pilot. We will draft a 90-day reconciliation cadence. We need Ben's cost model to ensure we don't lose margin on high-cold-traffic tenants.
- Restores: Pinecone will own low-latency restores for on-demand warm reads (we have the streaming glue). For bulk reindexes, happy to accept an initiation trigger from Redwood but Pinecone asks for 24-36h lead to stamp resources during busy windows.
- KMS: Pinecone supports customer-managed KMS for archived blobs in S3; however, using a remote KMS will add a modest latency (~100-200ms) on cold retrievals due to key unwrap. If that's acceptable we can document as a tradeoff. Karthik — flag if that latency impacts your SLO math.

I put a handful of comments directly in the SLA PDF and added a DocuSign link for signature when ready: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/abc123-embstore-sla

We can do the Friday 30-min sync — Amit 8am PT / Monica 11am ET works for our side.

—Amit
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Amit Shah <amit@pinecone.io>, Leah Park <leah@weaviate-partners.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 13:42:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Joint EmbStore ops proposal (SLA + incident play)

Locking this down from finance/commercials:

- Ben (finance) reviewed the 60/40 pilot split and is provisionally OK given a 90-day reconciliation and a clause that allows adjustment if cold retrievals exceed the forecast by >25%. I'll prepare a simple Excel model and attach to the Drive folder by EOD.
- Karthik: the KMS latency estimate is acceptable for the pilot, but we will add a customer config knob that lets customers choose cold-lane encryption vs. cost/latency tradeoff. We should capture that as an opt-in in the onboarding flow.
- Ops: Vanessa / Laura — please capture on-call rotation and escalation matrix (include Pinecone escalation level 2 contact). We will run the canary starting Wed 23 Sep for 7 days as proposed.

Monica — can you confirm you will publish the final playbook to the Drive and send the calendar invite for Friday's alignment call? Once agreed we will route the SLA for signatures (DocuSign link Amit provided).

Thanks — Ben
Finance / Partner GTM, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
